title: going to a concert at @The Garden THE DAY AFTER THE KNICKS WIN?!! i h...
transcript: I love that Taylor Swift wearing that Stevie Knicks shirt to Game 4 of the Knicks game led me to discovering and supporting a small business in my neighborhood that makes custom shirts And I'm going back for another one because tonight I'm going to Madison Square Garden to see 5 Seconds of Summer It's the second night of their, like, two night residency there my friends went last night and they made Knicks in 5(SOS) shirts So I'm going back to visit my friend JP at Creative Custom Clothing in Brooklyn We're gonna get us some Knicks in 5(SOS) shirts! Oh yeah OH YEAH Thank you so much! Incredible They look so good! I can't wait to put it on and show you. He also told me that you You guys sold him out of every Stevie Knicks shirt he could make He had none left. He was like, people were banging down the door, and I was like, I love the power of the internet! So thank you, J P. Creative Custom Clothing in Brooklyn If you need anything made, go to JP!
